topic: Technical vs. commercial capacity / further expansion plans (2026-2027)
wiki_text: Per Bloomberg (2026-07-15, paywalled/blocked for direct verification) as echoed independently by Kyiv Post (2026-07-15/16, verified): LNG Croatia managing director Ivan Fugas said the terminal's TECHNICAL maximum capacity reached 6.1 bcm/y (~4.5 mtpa) with the November 2025 regasification-module addition (already reflected in GEM as the 'Phase 1 Expansion' unit-row), but COMMERCIAL (contracted/bookable) capacity is separate and lower; the operator plans an auction in Q1 2027 for an additional ~1 bcm/y of commercial capacity, raising booked capacity to 4.5 bcm/y by early 2027, with successful bidders getting contracts valid through 2040. Framed in press as a potential boost to Ukraine's gas supply. This is a booking/contracting development, not a nameplate capacity change, so no Capacity field edit is staged.
